content.title: Grayscale Becomes Latest Crypto Company to File for IPO
content.description: Grayscale filed publicly for an initial public offering, the latest cryptocurrency-linked company to test public markets under an administration more open to digital assets. The company had net income of $203.3 million on revenue of $318.7 million for the nine months ended Sept. 30, according to its filing with the US SEC. Bloomberg's Isabelle Lee breaks down what the filing shows.
